title: Madhubanti's party
body: Madhubanti wants to organise a party. She will buy plates of snacks from the chaat shop in town. Each plate of snacks costs ₹25, and the shop charges an additional fixed amount of ₹50 to deliver the snacks to her house. There are 5 members in Madhubanti's family, including herself. Her parents tell her she can spend ₹500 in all on this party. She wants to give one plate of snacks to every person at the party, including her family and her friends. Her friend Mahesh lets p stand for the total number of people at the party and writes an equation for the total cost.
